+ "\n\n// PalettizedBlockLoader: loads a tile of dequantized weights from OCG blocks\n// into threadgroup memory for use with steel::BlockMMA.\n//\n// Thread mapping: channel-major — each thread owns one channel and a range\n// of k-positions. This is optimal for GPU because:\n//   - Low register pressure (4 slut values for 2-bit)\n//   - Coalesced TG writes (consecutive k-positions in same row)\n//   - High occupancy (few registers → many concurrent threads)\n//\n// ANE uses the opposite k-major layout (all channels at one k contiguous)\n// because ANE hardware broadcasts each input to all MACs processing different\n// output channels in parallel. GPU threads instead process k-positions in\n// parallel for a single channel. See ANE_PALETTIZED_MATMUL.md for details.\n//\n// Optimizations:\n//   1. Fixed thread-to-channel binding at construction\n//   2. Precomputed scaled_lut: slut[i] = lut[i]*scale+bias in registers\n//   3. uint8 reads with unroll-by-4 (2-bit): 4 values per loop iteration\n//   4. select()-based LUT lookup: branch-free, no variable array indexing\n//   5. Branch-free inner loop with precomputed effective count\n//\n// For transpose (reduction_dim=1): tile is [BROWS=BN, BCOLS=BK] from W[N,K]\n// For non-transpose (reduction_dim=0): tile is [BROWS=BK, BCOLS=BN] from W[N,K]\n\ntemplate <\n    typename T,\n    short BROWS,\n    short BCOLS,\n    short dst_ld,\n    short reduction_dim,\n    short tgp_size,\n    int bits,\n    int ocg_size>\nstruct PalettizedBlockLoader {\n\n  static constant constexpr const int num_lut = 1 << bits;\n\n  // Thread-to-work mapping\n  //\n  // Tile has BROWS rows (channels) × BCOLS cols (k-positions).\n  // With tgp_size=128, BROWS=32, BCOLS=32:\n  //   threads_per_channel = 128/32 = 4\n  //   k_per_thread = 32/4 = 8\n  //\n  // Thread assignment:\n  //   row = thread_idx / threads_per_channel  (channel index in tile)\n  //   k_slot = thread_idx % threads_per_channel\n  //   k_start = k_slot * k_per_thread\n\n  static constant constexpr const int total_channels = BROWS;\n  static constant constexpr const int threads_per_channel =\n      tgp_size / total_channels;\n  static constant constexpr const int k_per_thread =\n      (BCOLS + threads_per_channel -
